event PatientRegistered(address indexed patient, string name, uint256 timestamp)
event DoctorRegistered(address indexed doctor, string name, string specialization, string licenseNumber)
event MedicalRecordAdded(address indexed patient, uint256 indexed recordId, string recordType, string title)
event AccessGranted(address indexed patient, address indexed doctor, uint8 level, uint256 expiresAt)
event AccessRevoked(address indexed patient, address indexed doctor, uint256 timestamp)
event RecordAccessed(address indexed patient, address indexed doctor, uint256 indexed recordId, uint256 timestamp)
function addRecord(string _recordType, string _title, string _encryptedIpfsHash, string _dataHash, string _encryptedKey) returns (uint256)
function getMyRecords() view returns (tuple(uint256 id, string recordType, string title, string encryptedIpfsHash, string dataHash, string encryptedKey, uint256 createdAt)[])
function grantAccess(address _doctor, uint8 _level, uint256 _durationSeconds, string _encryptedKeyForDoctor, uint256[] _allowedRecordIds)
function checkAccess(address _patient, address _doctor, uint256 _recordId) view returns (bool hasAccess, uint8 level, string encryptedKey)

function accessRecord(address _patient, uint256 _recordId) returns (tuple(uint256 id, string recordType, string title, string encryptedIpfsHash, string dataHash, string encryptedKey, uint256 createdAt), string encryptedKeyForDoctor)

function getPatientRecordsAsDoctor(address _patient) view returns (tuple(uint256 id, string recordType, string title, string encryptedIpfsHash, string dataHash, string encryptedKey, uint256 createdAt)[])
function getMyGrants() view returns (tuple(address doctor, uint8 level, uint256 grantedAt, uint256 expiresAt, bool active, string encryptedKeyForDoctor, uint256[] allowedRecordIds)[])
function getAllDoctors() view returns (address[] addrs, tuple(string name, string specialization, string licenseNumber, bool registered, bool verified, uint256 registeredAt)[] profiles)
function patients(address) view returns (string name, string bloodType, bool registered, uint256 registeredAt)
function doctors(address) view returns (string name, string specialization, string licenseNumber, bool registered, bool verified, uint256 registeredAt)
